name: Data.varsigma_add_w_gap
summary: The weights w_j grow in steps of at least h (w_add_gap_le), h <= w_j, and rowParameter is explicit on both sides of k - 1; the case analysis is arithmetic.

steps.claim: For the place tau: w(D, j, tau) + (2 or 1) h(D) <= w(D, b, tau) for j < b, and w(D, a, tau) + (2 or 1) h(D) <= w(D, j, tau) for a < j.
steps.lean:
obtain _ := D.w_add_gap_le τ j,
      (D.w_add_gap_le τ · j);

steps.claim: Unfolding rowParameter(D, tau, p) (k/2 - 1 - p if p + 1 < k, h2 - w(D, p + 2 - k, tau) otherwise) and using h(D) = 2 h2(D) <= w(D, j, tau), both cases p < k + j - 1 and p >= k + j - 1 follow by linear arithmetic.

Not part of the proof: the next command, `grind_pattern`, registers this lemma for the grind tactic with the patterns rowParameter(D, tau, p) and w(D, j, tau); the line census counts it inside the declaration.
steps.lean: grind_pattern varsigma_add_w_gap => D.rowParameter τ p, D.w j τ
